Unsupported adapters retain named registrations and source paths; no pass is inferred from historical documents.
PK corpus fixtures are not GM/PK independent modeling equivalence; those registrations remain unsupported.
Historical topology-event documents disagree; current raw oracle evidence supersedes neither deleted evidence nor unexecuted scope.
